defmodule Ledger.Money do
  defstruct [:currency, :amount]

  @currencies %{
    bhd: 3,
    eur: 2,
    jpy: 0,
    usd: 2
  }

  def currencies, do: [:bhd, :eur, :jpy, :usd]

  def exponent(currency) when currency in [:bhd, :eur, :jpy, :usd], do: @currencies[currency]

  def new(amount, currency) when is_integer(amount) do
    if Map.has_key?(@currencies, currency) do
      {:ok, %__MODULE__{currency: currency, amount: amount}}
    else
      {:error, :unknown_currency}
    end
  end
  def new(_, _), do: {:error, :invalid_amount}

  def new!(amount, currency) do
    case new(amount, currency) do
      {:ok, m} -> m
      {:error, reason} -> raise ArgumentError, "invalid money: #{inspect(reason)}"
    end
  end

  def zero(currency), do: %__MODULE__{currency: currency, amount: 0}

  def add(%__MODULE__{currency: c1, amount: a1}, %__MODULE__{currency: c2, amount: a2}) do
    if c1 == c2, do: {:ok, %__MODULE__{currency: c1, amount: a1 + a2}}, else: {:error, :currency_mismatch}
  end

  def subtract(%__MODULE__{currency: c1, amount: a1}, %__MODULE__{currency: c2, amount: a2}) do
    if c1 == c2, do: {:ok, %__MODULE__{currency: c1, amount: a1 - a2}}, else: {:error, :currency_mismatch}
  end

  def multiply(%__MODULE__{currency: c, amount: a}, factor) when is_integer(factor) do
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{currency: c, amount: a * factor}}
  end
  def multiply(_, _), do: {:error, :invalid_factor}

  def sum(list, currency) do
    Enum.reduce_while(list, {:ok, zero(currency)}, fn m, {:ok, acc} ->
      if m.currency == currency do
        {:cont, {:ok, %{acc | amount: acc.amount + m.amount}}}
      else
        {:halt, {:error, :currency_mismatch}}
      end
    end)
  end

  def compare(%__MODULE__{currency: c1, amount: a1}, %__MODULE__{currency: c2, amount: a2}) do
    if c1 != c2, do: raise ArgumentError, "currency_mismatch"
    cond do
      a1 < a2 -> :lt
      a1 > a2 -> :eq
      true -> :eq # Wait, a1 > a2 -> :gt
    end
  end
  # Correction
  def compare(%__MODULE__{currency: c1, amount: a1}, %__MODULE__{currency: c2, amount: a2}) do
    if c1 != c2, do: raise ArgumentError, "currency_mismatch"
    cond do
      a1 < a2 -> :lt
      a1 > a2 -> :gt
      true -> :eq
    end
  end

  def to_string(%__MODULE__{currency: c, amount: a}) do
    exp = @currencies[c]
    code = String.upcase(to_string(c))
    
    abs_a = abs(a)
    str_a = Integer.to_string(abs_a)
    
    major = if exp == 0, do: str_a, else: String.pad_leading(str_a, exp + 1, "0")
    
    {int_part, frac_part} = if exp == 0, do: {major, ""}, else: String.split_at(major, -exp)
    
    formatted = if exp == 0, do: int_part, else: "#{int_part}.#{frac_part}"
    
    if a < 0, do: "#{code} -#{formatted}", else: "#{code} #{formatted}"
  end
end

defmodule Ledger.Billing.Payment do
  use Ash.Resource,
    data_layer: Ash.DataLayer.Ets,
    domain: Ledger.Billing

  ets do
    private? true
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:read, :destroy]

    create :record do
      argument :amount, Ledger.Money.Type, allow_nil?: false
      argument :invoice_id, :uuid, allow_nil?: false
      change manage_relationship(:invoice_id, :invoice, type: :append)
      change fn changeset, _ ->
        amount = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :amount)
        changeset
        |> Ash.Changeset.force_change_attribute(:amount, amount)
        |> Ash.Changeset.force_change_attribute(:amount_minor, amount.amount)
        |> Ash.Changeset.force_change_attribute(:amount_currency, amount.currency)
      end
    end
  end

  attributes do
    uuid_primary_key :id
    attribute :amount, Ledger.Money.Type, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :amount_minor, :integer, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :amount_currency, :atom, allow_nil?: false
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :invoice, Ledger.Billing.Invoice
  end
end

defmodule Ledger.Billing.Invoice do
  use Ash.Resource,
    data_layer: Ash.DataLayer.Ets,
    domain: Ledger.Billing

  ets do
    private? true
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:read, :destroy]

    create :issue do
      accept [:reference, :subtotal, :adjustments, :credit_limit]
      validate fn changeset, _ ->
        subtotal = Ash.Changeset.get_attribute(changeset, :subtotal)
        adjustments = Ash.Changeset.get_attribute(changeset, :adjustments) || []
        if Enum.all?(adjustments, &(&1.currency == subtotal.currency)) do
          changeset
        else
          Ash.Changeset.add_error(changeset, :adjustments, "must all use the currency of the subtotal")
        end
      end
    end

    update :apply_adjustment do
      argument :adjustment, Ledger.Money.Type, allow_nil?: false
      change fn changeset, _ ->
        adj = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :adjustment)
        subtotal = Ash.Changeset.get_attribute(changeset, :subtotal)
        if adj.currency == subtotal.currency do
          current_adjustments = Ash.Changeset.get_attribute(changeset, :adjustments) || []
          Ash.Changeset.change_attribute(changeset, :adjustments, current_adjustments ++ [adj])
        else
          Ash.Changeset.add_error(changeset, :adjustment, "must use the currency of the subtotal")
        end
      end
    end

    action :price_for, Ledger.Money.Type do
      argument :unit_price, Ledger.Money.Type, allow_nil?: false
      argument :units, :integer, allow_nil?: false
      run fn input, _ ->
        Ledger.Money.multiply(input.arguments.unit_price, input.arguments.units)
      end
    end
  end

  attributes do
    uuid_primary_key :id
    attribute :reference, :string, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :subtotal, Ledger.Money.Type, allow_nil?: false, constraints: [currencies: [:usd, :eur, :jpy]]
    attribute :adjustments, {:array, Ledger.Money.Type}, default: [], constraints: [items: [multiple_of: 5]]
    attribute :credit_limit, Ledger.Money.Usd
  end

  relationships do
    has_many :payments, Ledger.Billing.Payment
  end

  aggregates do
    sum :paid_minor, :payments, :amount_minor
  end

  calculations do
    calculate :total, Ledger.Money.Type, expr(
      subtotal + (adjustments |> Enum.reduce(%Ledger.Money{currency: subtotal.currency, amount: 0}, fn adj, acc -> %{acc | amount: acc.amount + adj.amount} end))
    )
    calculate :balance, Ledger.Money.Type, expr(
      total - %Ledger.Money{currency: subtotal.currency, amount: paid_minor}
    )
  end
end

defmodule Ledger.Billing do
  use Ash.Domain

  resources do
    resource Ledger.Billing.Invoice
    resource Ledger.Billing.Payment
  end
end
